inlines.v: ALTHE'A, noun [Gr. to heal.] In botany, a genus of polyandrian monadelphs, of several species; called in English marsh-mallow. The common species has a perennial root, and an annual stalk rising four or five feet. It abounds with mucilage, and is used as an emollient.
